source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Naveen,

How are you today? Apologies for the delay. I had to think whether I had any additional questions.

\- How do I know if a person is already in the CRM? - Will I know it only after I hit the 'Export' button and get a 'duplicate' alert in CRM, or will I see it when looking at their profile on LinkedIn?

\- When I export data from Sales Navigator to the CRM, will I get LinkedIn profile links, but not Sales Navigator links (they are different)?

\- What does 'Lead Management System' cover?

\- Will we see emailing/LinkedIn chat history for leads inside Hubspot?

\- How do we add silent leads to follow-up campaigns without having to manually du it in MeetAlfred? Let me explain what I mean. Let's say, we created List A and List B in the CRM, and uploaded them into MeetAlfred. After a while, there are silent leads in both. I move silent leads from these lists to a new one, List C, to run a follow-up campaign. How do I make sure that this new list can be seamlessly exported to MeetAlfred without me having to manually clean the former two campaigns?

value_updates.membership_check: Determine whether a person is already represented in the CRM before adding that person again

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Thanks for your reply. Here are my answers:

1\. How do I know if a person is already in the CRM? - Will I know it only after I hit the 'Export' button and get a 'duplicate' alert in CRM, or will I see it when looking at their profile on LinkedIn?

There are two ways to make it possible:

a. To make it work, we need to use <http://Apollo.io|Apollo.io> Google chrome extension which comes free. In this we need to change the flowchart a bit. Instead of exporting the leads to Hubspot CRM directly, we will export them in <http://Apollo.io|Apollo.io> and from there, enriched data will be exported to Hubspot. LinkedIn will show the leads saved in <http://Apollo.io|Apollo.io> so we can avoid adding them.

b. We can take a subscription of Linkmatch which integrates LinkedIn and Hubspot in a way that you can easily see on the persons profile that he is in CRM or not. If he's not in CRM you can add them to CRM in just one click.

2\. When I export data from Sales Navigator to the CRM, will I get LinkedIn profile links, but not Sales Navigator links (they are different)?

Ans. With normal integration, we get Sales Navigator Data and link in Hubspot. However. if we enrich the data through <http://Apollo.io|Apollo.io> or LinkMatch, we get normail linkedIn URL

3\. What does 'Lead Management System' cover?

Ans. It's a system where I would create custom properties, Tags, Lead nurturing system, define stages of leads and categorize them properly. List creations for dead or any other leads. It also includes Notes and Task assigning system

Will we see emailing/LinkedIn chat history for leads inside Hubspot?

Ans. With the help of Zaps it's possible

How do we add silent leads to follow-up campaigns without having to manually du it in MeetAlfred? Let me explain what I mean. Let's say, we created List A and List B in the CRM, and uploaded them into MeetAlfred. After a while, there are silent leads in both. I move silent leads from these lists to a new one, List C, to run a follow-up campaign. How do I make sure that this new list can be seamlessly exported to MeetAlfred without me having to manually clean the former two campaigns?

Ans. For this step, I need to check in Meet Alfred. However, it's possible to do this with the help of CRM. We need create a few workflows inside the CRM system for that.

ambiguity.description: The freelancer proposes Apollo-based saved-lead visibility and LinkMatch-based direct CRM visibility, but the client has not selected a mechanism for this behavior.

routing_warnings.description: The subscription obstacle concerns direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization rather than CRM-membership visibility on a LinkedIn profile.
This message defines the accepted LinkedIn-to-Apollo export flow but does not state that existing CRM membership will be shown while reviewing a LinkedIn profile.
The observed transfer of 23 contacts verifies LinkedIn-to-Apollo export, not duplicate-membership visibility.
